components.name: Auto-Resize Textarea
components.description: A textarea component that automatically adjusts its height based on content

demo.html:
<textarea class="tw-auto-resize form-control" name="Multiline" placeholder="Enter your message...">First Line
  Second Line
    Third Line</textarea>

cssClasses.description: Primary class that enables auto-resize functionality

events.trigger: When content changes and element loses focus

components.name: List Input
components.description: A dynamic input component for managing lists of items with add/remove functionality

demo.html: <input class="form-control" name="ListInput" placeholder="List Input" type="list" value='["One","Two","Three"]' />

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Must be set to "list" to activate component

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: JSON array string of initial items

events.trigger: When items are added or removed

components.name: Passkey Input
components.description: Secure WebAuthn passkey registration and verification component

demo.html: <input class="btn" data-identifier="j@ne.com" data-user="Jane" id="passkey-input" name="Passkey" type="passkey" />

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Must be set to "passkey" to activate component

events.trigger: When passkey is registered or removed

components.notes: The passkey value will NOT appear at `event.formData[name]` during a submit event. Instead, the public key will be broadcasted in `event.currentTarget.value` during `change` events.

components.name: PIN Input
components.description: Secure PIN entry with individual digit boxes and customizable length

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Must be set to "pin" to activate component

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: Placeholder text shown in empty boxes

components.name: Select Input
components.description: Enhanced select dropdown with search, multi-select, and grouping capabilities

demo.single:
<select class="tw-select-group form-control" data-placeholder="Single Select" data-type="number" name="SingleSelect">
  <option class="tw-option" value="1">Albuquerque</option>
  <option class="tw-option" value="2">Boston</option>
  <option class="tw-option" value="3">Chicago</option>
</select>
demo.multiple:
<select class="tw-select-group form-control" data-placeholder="Multiple Select" multiple name="MultipleSelect">
  <option class="tw-option" value="alb">Albuquerque</option>
  <option class="tw-option" value="bos">Boston</option>
  <option class="tw-option" value="chi">Chicago</option>
</select>
demo.grouped:
<select class="tw-select-group form-control" data-placeholder="Multiple Select" multiple name="MultipleSelect">
  <option class="tw-option" value="alb" data-group="West">Albuquerque</option>
  <option class="tw-option" value="bos" data-group="East">Boston</option>
  <option class="tw-option" value="chi" data-group="East">Chicago</option>
</select>

components.basicUsage:
<select class="tw-select-group" name="city" data-placeholder="Select a city">
  <option class="tw-option" value="1">New York</option>
  <option class="tw-option" value="2">Los Angeles</option>
  <option class="tw-option" value="3">Chicago</option>
</select>

cssClasses.description: Required class to activate enhanced select

attributes.name: data-placeholder
attributes.description: Placeholder text shown when no selection

components.name: Signature Input
components.description: Interactive canvas component for capturing handwritten signatures

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Must be set to "signature" to activate

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: Text shown when canvas is empty

components.notes: The value attribute contains a base64-encoded PNG image of the signature.
